[![PyPI version](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/py-qte?logo=pypi&logoColor=white)](https://pypi.org/project/py-qte/)
[![Python versions](https://img.shields.io/pypi/pyversions/py-qte?logo=python&logoColor=white)](https://pypi.org/project/py-qte/)
[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/mohelm/py-qte?logo=github&label=GitHub)](https://github.com/mohelm/py-qte)

Quantile treatment effects in Python — the [py-qte](https://github.com/mohelm/py-qte) package is a
fast implementation with beautiful result presentations of some of the estimators in the R
[`qte`](https://github.com/bcallaway11/qte) package.

You can find some benchmarks comparing the `py-qte` and the `qte` package [here](benchmark.qmd).
